problem: Suppose $|\,c\,|=18$ and the angle between vectors $c$ and $d$ is $\theta =\frac{3\pi }{4}.$ Find the scalar projection of $c$ onto $d.$

feedback.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{u}\,t & =|\,t\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =\sqrt{2}cos\,(\frac{3\pi }{4}) \\  & =\sqrt{2}\cdot (-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}) \\  & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$
